title: Cape Canaveral launch site

place.label: Cape Canaveral, Florida, United States
place.basis: One Wikidata (CC0) coordinate for the whole site; a spaceport covers many square kilometres

measures.label: Launch site named in NASA's catalogue

facts.text: NASA's catalogue lists Cape Canaveral, United States, as the launch site of the Apollo 11 Lunar Module's mission (launched 16 July 1969, on a Saturn 5).

tiers.everyday: Cape Canaveral is a US launch site in Florida. NASA's catalogue lists it as the launch site of the Apollo 11 mission.
tiers.student: NASA's NSSDCA catalogue lists the launch site of the Apollo 11 Lunar Module's mission as Cape Canaveral, United States, on 1969-07-16. This entry is one generic point for the site and adds no local detail; the Apollo 11 entry covers the mission.

unknowns: Everything else about the site: left out on purpose (owner pick: one generic point, no local detail)
